set.body:
Milestone acceptance gate P8: Surfaces, viewers and documentation. Aggregation/review gate, not a work packet. Required packets: P8.01, P8.02, P8.03, P8.04, P8.05. Native blocks edges require their accepted completion; containment is non-blocking. See docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Exit: verify the phase exit criteria in docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md, exact source/provider pins, bounded JVM and JS receipts, oracle manifests and declared caveats. A filed ticket, unrun test or renamed legacy path does not satisfy the gate. Append a receipt to the plan's Receipts section.

Owner role: phase integrator with independent review.
set.title: STP-P8 GATE: Surfaces, viewers and documentation
